key.text: I want to record a podcast episode with two friends about campus food. We need microphones and a quiet room.

needs.why: Need microphones and a quiet room to record the podcast episode.

steps.title: Prepare the file
steps.detail: Plan your podcast topics about campus food and check your recording plan.

steps.title: Reserve the studio
steps.detail: Email spaces@usc.edu or call the ITS Learning Environments team at (213) 821-6601 to reserve the podcast studio.

steps.title: Record your episode
steps.detail: Go to the digital creative lab in Leavey Library at your scheduled time and use the podcast studio equipment.

routes.process: Record in a podcast studio with headsets and a mixer
routes.fit_reason: This route provides a dedicated podcast studio with seats for four people, matching your need for a quiet room and microphones. It is simple to use since no training is required.

steps.title: Prepare the file
steps.detail: Plan what you will say about campus food and check your recording equipment needs.

steps.title: Contact the lab
steps.detail: Email the lab at lvy@usc.edu to ask what you can use and when.

steps.title: Collect and record
steps.detail: Visit Ahmanson Lab during lab hours to get the microphones and record your episode.

routes.process: Record using studio microphones and an audio interface
routes.fit_reason: This route gives you professional microphones and audio equipment to record your conversation. It is a straightforward option for capturing clear sound.

output.summary: Record a podcast episode with two friends about campus food using microphones and a quiet room.
